text: {"opportunities":[{"name":"GitHub developer lead email draft","description":"For a given GitHub username, search the user, open the profile and top repo, gather followers/top repo/latest post, and draft a lead email to hiring@example.com with a role-specific subject.","site":"github","steps":["Click GitHub global search and type the username, press Enter","Click the 'Users' results filter","Open the matching user profile","Note follower count and latest post","Open the top repository and note stars and language","Open mail compose, enter To hiring@example.com","Enter subject 'Lead for <role>: <username>'","Enter body '<username>: <followers> followers, top repo <repo> (<stars> stars, <language>), latest post: <post>.'","Discard/save the draft"],"parameters":["github username","role title","followers","top repo","stars","language","latest post"],"confidence":0.9,"instances":[{"start_t":139.2,"end_t":324,"values":"karpathy; ML Research Engineer; nanoGPT 63.8k stars"},{"start_t":448.5,"end_t":505,"values":"gaearon (typo gaeron corrected); Staff Frontend Engineer; react/react 251.0k stars"},{"start_t":777.5,"end_t":836.5,"values":"simonw; Developer Advocate; llm 12.6k stars"}]},{"name":"Wikipedia person lookup plus Wayback snapshot note","description":"Look up a person on Wikipedia, then view an archive.org snapshot of their company's homepage from a given year and record a note combining both.","site":"wikipedia / archive.org / notes","steps":["Search the person's name on Wikipedia","Read key facts (birth date, role)","Open archive.org Wayback and enter the company domain","Select the year and a snapshot date","Read the homepage headline","Add a note combining person facts and the snapshot text"],"parameters":["person name","company domain","year","snapshot"],"confidence":0.4,"instances":[{"start_t":332.6,"end_t":417.7,"values":"Satya Nadella; microsoft.com; 2014"},{"start_t":509.3,"end_t":537,"values":"Jacinda Ardern; Wayback lookup started (incomplete)"}]}]}

opportunities.name: GitHub developer lead email draft
opportunities.description: For a given GitHub username, search the user, open the profile and top repo, gather followers/top repo/latest post, and draft a lead email to hiring@example.com with a role-specific subject.
steps: Click GitHub global search and type the username, press Enter
Note follower count and latest post
Open the top repository and note stars and language
Open mail compose, enter To hiring@example.com
Enter body '<username>: <followers> followers, top repo <repo> (<stars> stars, <language>), latest post: <post>.'

instances.values: karpathy; ML Research Engineer; nanoGPT 63.8k stars
gaearon (typo gaeron corrected); Staff Frontend Engineer; react/react 251.0k stars

opportunities.name: Wikipedia person lookup plus Wayback snapshot note
opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia, then view an archive.org snapshot of their company's homepage from a given year and record a note combining both.
steps: Search the person's name on Wikipedia
Open archive.org Wayback and enter the company domain
Select the year and a snapshot date
Add a note combining person facts and the snapshot text
